title: Rav Menashya son of Rava

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Beitzah 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.30b.10). The Bach reads “Rav Menashya said in the name of Shmuel,” as does the Venice printing.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Menashya son of Rava. Hyman attributes “Rav Menashya said in the name of Shmuel” to the Bach and the Venice printing.
[Earlier on the same folio](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.30b.3), Rav Menashya speaks after Rav Yehudah’s report in Shmuel’s name. There Rav Menashya has no patronymic.
